source.title: fix(k8s): set the verification window in the example ConfigMap (#3986)

criteria: The example ConfigMap sets `ai.tasks.verification.context_window` to a value that fits the model of the task (256000 for `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`), with a comment that gives the reason.
A test fails when the verification window of the example ConfigMap is below the least window of a review run.
The decision on a failed review run whose window ends its tools too soon is recorded: it fails the item, or it is advice.
